'''Enaila''' is a [[Maiden of the Spear]]. She is of the [[Jarra (sept)|Jarra]] sept of the [[Chareen]] [[Aiel]]. 
She regards [[Rand al'Thor]] as a son.

==Appearance==
She is a fiery redhead and very short, which she is touchy about.

==Activities==
She is one of the Maiden's who stand guard over Rand in [[Rhuidean]]{{ref/book|5|3}} and then when he meets all the nobles after the battle with the [[Shaido]] in [[Cairhien]]. After [[Sulin]] confronts Rand about keeping the Maiden's out of the attack on [[Caemlyn]], Enaila is the first in line to greet Rand when he returns their honor and allows them to join in the attack.

She, along with [[Adelin]] and [[Jolien]], shaved [[Isendre]] bald and beat her with nettles after catching her again trying to sneak into Rand's bed in [[Eianrod]], [[Cairhien]].

She greets [[Min Farshaw]] when she arrives in [[Caemlyn]] but is not impressed with the amount of affection Rand shows Min. She accompanies Rand when he Travels to Caemlyn after he had been captured by the [[White Tower]] [[Aes Sedai]].

After Rand's long leave of absence, she again becomes one of his body guards, this time guarding him in [[Algarin Pendaloan]]'s mansion in [[Tear]]. She fights in the battle with the [[Trollocs]], when they try and attack the manor and even saves Rand at one point by throwing a spear into an attacking [[Myrddraal]].

She decided to forsake the Maidens and made a bridal wreath for the ''[[siswai'aman]]'' [[Leiran]]. She died in the Last battle at the [[Field of Merrilor]], speared to the gut by four Trollocs.

== Viewing ==
Min sees a wreath above her head. (Fulfilled)
